newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice- Ice thickens, new restrictions due.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice- Ice thickens, new restrictions due.

text.p: Ice thickened off coasts in the Gulf of Bothnia and new ice stretched across the eastern Gulf of Finland, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said in its twice-weekly report.

It tightened restrictions in the Northern Gulf of Bothnia to ice class IA and 4,000 deadweight tonnes for Tornio, Kemi, Oulu and Raahe, IA and 3,000 tonnes for Kokkola and Pietarsaari and IA and 2,000 tonnes for Vaasa.
Other restrictions were unchanged, an institute official said by telephone on Tuesday.

Three icebreakers were on station near St Petersburg and Vyborg in the eastern Gulf of Finland, four in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia, two in the middle, and one outside Rauma in the south of the Gulf of Bothnia.
One ice-breaker was on station outside Porvoo in the Gulf of Finland and one was outside Parnu in the Gulf of Riga.

NOTES: New ice - forming, thin and still moving. Fast ice - not moving level flat ice. Level ice - thick flat ice.

Consolidated/compact - compact close ice. Windrow ice - reshaped by wind, thickness varies sharply. Rafted - ridges forming, 10-20 cm thick. Ridged - ridged or hummocked ice. Open - floes with water at rate of 4-6:10. Close ice - floes tightly packed.
